# Reconcile 0.15 source provenance and publish a verified implementation inventory

Release: [0.15 delivery](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/422). Area: **A00**. Parent: [SF-A00-T11](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/14).

## Deliverable

Audit current Git refs and any explicitly supplied 0.15 snapshot, map exact commits to release requirements, and distinguish implemented, partial, absent and unqualified behavior. Do not rebuild a duplicate feature or treat conversational claims as recovered code.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record source/archive hashes, provenance and relevant changed paths; absent earlier snapshots are explicitly absent, not silently relabeled 0.14.

- [ ] For every requirement, link the existing implementation issue and identify a runnable test or a concrete missing-test task.

- [ ] Preserve current main and CI fixes; propose focused recovery PRs to the appropriate owning area instead of mixing product edits into this audit.

- [ ] Inventory includes document designer lifecycle, two apps/two instances, app-only HTML downloads, real Git auth, GPU fallbacks and numerical/network operations.

- [ ] Provide exact commands, environments, last verified commits, failing logs and remaining blockers; no artifact link without a real asset and integrity check.

## Dependencies

No code prerequisite; an ownership lease is still required.

## Parallel-agent ownership

Write only: `planning/release15-evidence/**`

These are proposed paths, not claims that modules already exist. Claim a narrow file lease before coding. The parent task must not have another agent editing the same implementation concurrently.

Shared framework IDs, runtime dispatchers and studio.js remain owned by A00/A19 integration. Submit an adapter request instead of editing another area. Keep product implementation out of qualification-only tasks.

## Handoff and completion

Agent: unassigned. Branch: not created. Lease: not claimed. Record last verified commit, exact paths, heartbeat/expiry, prerequisites, commands, artifacts and blockers. A project card is not a lock or proof of readiness.

Add positive/negative, cancellation/disposal and cross-engine tests as applicable. Close only with merged, reproducible evidence. Unsupported platforms and missing real-hardware/provider tests remain explicit. Do not close broader parity parents when only this slice is complete.
